purpose: CA-114 daily-source reconciliation for 2465 payment certificates/private placement. Add official TWSE MI_QFIIS date-specific issued-share observations and falsify equivalence between that reported issued-share field, registered-issued common shares, and exchange-listed/tradable supply.

auxiliaryFields: 最近一次上市公司申報外資及陸資持股異動日期
twseMiQfiisContract.reason2Meaning: Company filing can be triggered by capital change, fixed-base-date reporting, correction of prior filing, overseas securities issuance, merger, tender offer, and related filing situations.
twseMiQfiisContract.semanticGuard: The official daily field belongs to the foreign-investment holdings reporting table. Its timing can follow company-reporting rules and must not be assumed identical to MOEA registration or exchange-listed/tradable common shares.

conclusion: MI_QFIIS 發行股數 steps from 83,946,031 to 93,946,031 on 2025-11-12, before payment certificates begin trading on 2025-11-17 and before MOEA registration approval on 2026-01-06.
Therefore MI_QFIIS 發行股數 is not an admissible proxy for point-in-time REGISTERED_ISSUED_COMMON_SHARES.
It is also not proof of EXCHANGE_LISTED_COMMON_SHARES or COMBINED_EXCHANGE_TRADABLE_UNITS because the step precedes the payment-certificate trading start.
The same numeric value can belong to different semantic/reporting stages at different clocks; field-name equality is not semantic equality.

registeredIssuedCommonShares.quality: PRE_REGISTRATION_STATE; MI_QFIIS 93,946,031 explicitly rejected as substitute
